page_title: FUL 3-1 NEW | Fulham v Newcastle 21/09/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The match has just finished.
90+2' 3 - 1 Goal! It's a catastrophic error from the opponent which has gifted a chance to Reiss Nelson (Fulham), who rolls the ball into the back of the net from close range. 3:1.
90+1' Bernd Leno (Fulham) infringed the rules and goes into the book. Peter Bankes pulls out a yellow card.
90' There will be a minimum of 6 min. of added time.

88' Harvey Barnes (Newcastle Utd) creates himself some space in front of goal and connects with the resulting free kick. His header is slightly mistimed and sails inches wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Fulham will have a goal kick.
88' The referee blows his whistle as Harrison Reed (Fulham) was too aggressive in his challenge. It's a free kick to Newcastle in a dangerous position.
86' A yellow card for a tackle by Harrison Reed (Fulham). Peter Bankes doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
86' Alex Iwobi (Fulham) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
84' Marco Silva has decided to make a change. Issa Diop (Fulham) replaces Emile Smith Rowe.
82' The game has come to an end for Anthony Gordon. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of William Osula (Newcastle Utd).
81' The possession of the ball – 40:60.
76' Reiss Nelson (Fulham) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
74' Here is a change. Kieran Trippier is going off and Eddie Howe gives the last tactical orders to Valentino Livramento (Newcastle Utd).
74' It is time for a substitution. Sandro Tonali (Newcastle Utd) is on for Joelinton.
74' The substitution is prepared. Rodrigo Muniz (Fulham) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Raul Jimenez.
74' Marco Silva has decided to substitute Adama Traore and he is replaced by Reiss Nelson (Fulham).

71' Bernd Leno makes a brilliant save! Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) easily weaves through the defence and fires the ball from mid-range. His effort goes towards the bottom right corner but is saved by the keeper!
70' Alexander Isak (Newcastle Utd) gets on the end of a pass and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's blocked by one of the defending players.
67' Substitution. Andreas Pereira makes way for Harrison Reed (Fulham).

66' Bruno Guimaraes (Newcastle Utd) latches on to a precise pass on the edge of the box, but miskicks his shot and the ball goes high over the bar. Poor effort! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Fulham.
65' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Jacob Murphy (Newcastle Utd).
64' Antonee Robinson (Fulham) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
63' Alex Iwobi (Fulham) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
61' Peter Bankes blows his whistle after Bruno Guimaraes (Newcastle Utd) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle.
60' Andreas Pereira (Fulham) gets the ball and drives a shot high over the bar from the edge of the area.

60' Emile Smith Rowe (Fulham) covers his face with his hands after wasting a promising chance. He takes the rebound on the edge of the box but blazes the ball high over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Newcastle.
59' The resulting set piece, sent into the penalty area by Andreas Pereira (Fulham), was easily dealt with by one of the defenders.

58' Dan Burn (Newcastle Utd) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Peter Bankes with no other option than to blow for a foul.
58' Emile Smith Rowe loses the ball after receiving a sweet pass from Alex Iwobi (Fulham).
56' A long ball forward to Joelinton (Newcastle Utd) is intercepted.
54' Fulham can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

53' Raul Jimenez (Fulham) controls the ball from the corner kick and takes a shot from the edge of the box towards the left side of the goal. The goalkeeper has a clear sight of the shot and thwarts him with a comfortable save. The referee points to the corner flag and Fulham will take a corner.
53' Andreas Pereira (Fulham) will try to find the head of one of his teammates from a corner kick.

53' Alex Iwobi (Fulham) meets the lofted pass inside the box with a well placed shot towards the middle of the goal, but Nick Pope pulls off a fantastic save to deny him. Fulham will take a corner kick.

51' Harvey Barnes (Newcastle Utd) wastes a big opportunity! He controls the ball after a nice low pass and shoots from a promising distance. His poor effort goes miles wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Fulham will have a goal kick.
51' Alex Iwobi (Fulham) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
51' A cross into the box from Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) is cleared.
49' No offside! Referee Peter Bankes points to the centre spot to indicate that the goal stands after the VAR review. That prompts big celebrations from the Newcastle players.
48' The Newcastle players halt their celebrations as referee Peter Bankes makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was an offside in the build-up play.

47' 2 - 1 Jacob Murphy looks around to decide who he is going to pass to. He picks out Harvey Barnes (Newcastle Utd), who collects the ball and unleashes a terrific shot from just outside of the box towards the bottom right corner and it ricochets in off the post. The score is 2:1.
46' Half-time substitution. Joe Willock (Newcastle Utd) will not participate anymore and Jacob Murphy is coming on.
46' Marco Silva has made a change at the break. Sander Berge has come on in place of Sasa Lukic (Fulham).
46' The need to improve in the second half has brought about a change. Lloyd Kelly (Newcastle Utd) comes off for Lewis Hall.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+1' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+1' Harvey Barnes (Newcastle Utd) is flagged for offside.
45' 1 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
44' Andreas Pereira (Fulham) has tested the patience of referee Peter Bankes and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
44' Harvey Barnes (Newcastle Utd) sends a cross into the box, but Bernd Leno comes off his line to gather the ball.

41' Fine play by Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) opens up space on the edge of the box for the shot, but his effort lacks accuracy and flies miles over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Fulham.
41' Alex Iwobi (Fulham) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away.
40' Adama Traore (Fulham) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence. Fulham win a corner.

37' That was a nice football moment. Joachim Andersen (Fulham) receives an amazing defence-splitting low pass on the edge of the box and blasts the ball towards the top left corner. Nick Pope guesses his intention and dives superbly to deny him with a remarkable save!
36' The expression of the referee Peter Bankes is crystal clear. This behaviour won't be tolerated. Adama Traore (Fulham) is shown a yellow card.
35' Andreas Pereira (Fulham) takes the corner kick but the ball only finds the head of an opponent.

35' Adama Traore (Fulham) beats the defender inside the box and lashes a shot towards the bottom right corner, but Nick Pope makes a brilliant reflex save to deny him. Goalkeeping at its best! The ball is out of play and Fulham manage to earn a corner.

34' Harvey Barnes (Newcastle Utd) meets a pass on the edge of the penalty area and shoots towards the middle of the goal. He didn't put enough power into the effort, though, and Bernd Leno pulls off an easy save.
33' That's unlucky! Joelinton (Newcastle Utd) beautifully controls a pass and from the edge of the box drills a shot in on goal, but it's inadvertently blocked by a defender and cleared.
32' Harvey Barnes (Newcastle Utd) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
28' Sasa Lukic (Fulham) receives a yellow card for a nasty tackle.

28' Raul Jimenez (Fulham) latches on to an accurate pass inside the box and immediately unleashes a shot towards goal, but it goes high over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Newcastle.
27' We can have a look at the statistics now, particularly the total attempts – 6:0.
22' 2 - 0 GOAL after a blunder! Keeper Nick Pope makes a complete hash of a weak close range shot from Emile Smith Rowe (Fulham) and let’s the ball squirm into the net. It’s now 2:0.
21' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Kenny Tete (Fulham) was quite harsh and Peter Bankes didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
21' Kenny Tete (Fulham) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
19' Lloyd Kelly (Newcastle Utd) is caught offside!

17' Alex Iwobi (Fulham) latches on to a precise defence-splitting pass and fires a nice strike from a promising distance towards the middle of the goal. Nick Pope has a clear sight of it and makes a comfortable save.
17' Kenny Tete (Fulham) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.
16' A rebound falls kindly for Antonee Robinson (Fulham), but his shot from the edge of the box flies high over bar. None too pretty! The ball goes out of play and Newcastle will have a goal kick.
16' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Fulham.

15' Raul Jimenez (Fulham) receives a precise pass and is given time inside the box to send a promising strike towards the bottom right corner. Nick Pope guesses his intention and denies him with a fine save. The linesman points to the corner flag, Fulham are going to take it.
13' Adama Traore (Fulham) commits a rough challenge and Peter Bankes blows his whistle for a foul.
12' Harvey Barnes (Newcastle Utd) does his best to latch onto a cross into the box, but he can't get to the ball.

8' Emile Smith Rowe (Fulham) is found in space by a decent pass, and he immediately hits a rocket of a shot at goal that clips the top of the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Newcastle.
5' 1 - 0 Raul Jimenez (Fulham) has acres of space after latching on to a precise pass into the box. He doesn't hesitate to release a low effort which ends up in the bottom right corner.
4' Joelinton (Newcastle Utd) has a goal ruled out for offside!
2' Adama Traore (Fulham) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
1' The match has just started.
Fulham will kick-off.
Let us introduce today's referee to you, and it's Peter Bankes.
Show lineups The starting XIs were already announced and you can go through them in the Lineups section.
Show lineups
Hello and welcome to our live text commentary! We will provide you with instant updates of everything that happens in the match. The starting lineups will be announced very soon.
